judgment: Configured values, speech/notification controls, calendar, thread-empty and account sections fit the phone scroll sequence. Auto-collapse now has a full-row semantic label instead of a checkbox-only target.
Unset timezone and collapse are named explicitly; calendar action remains disabled until configured. Reviewed personal and calendar sections.
Unavailable owner values remain distinct from unset and do not pretend to be editable; explanatory text wraps. Reviewed personal and calendar sections.
Settings loading remains explicit without guessed registry values; the top-level loading composition fits.
Settings error and Retry settings are readable and reachable; failed registry is not displayed as empty success.
Administrator registry beginning, middle sample and ending sections were viewed; sampled owner rows and detail wrapping fit. Not every intermediate owner row was visually inspected.
Opened long owner coordinate wraps within the panel; finite long calendar name and upstream error remain readable. These content boundaries were inspected.

Selected synthetic thread and model/thinking/speed/timeout remain visible after native auth restoration. Fixed unchanged identity events clearing thread selection; both selected-thread sections were viewed.
Calendar failure has Retry and now says to reload the calendar timezone, rather than falsely asking to set an already configured timezone.
Pending Android installer status fits and the action now matches its instruction: Update, not Check for updates. Reviewed update and account sections.
Native update error wraps and leaves a reachable enabled check/retry action; reviewed update and account sections.
Applying update is explicitly busy with a disabled Updating action; reviewed update and account sections.
Live-media waiting status is legible and distinct from applying; reviewed update and account sections.

Both preferences now use full-row labels. Actual label click changes phone control off to checked/Reconnecting. Expanded grant list also inspected in sheet-permissions-off.png; grant states and prerequisite-disabled background location fit.
Reconnecting is explicit, separate from connected; preference labels provide full-row targets and status text fits.
Expanded grant list inspected through its ending. Granted states do not show unnecessary Grant actions; independent overlay preference remains distinct from its capability.
Expanded absent-capability list inspected; unavailable is not interpreted as granted, and disabled preferences remain legible.
Checking this phone is the only status while pending; no capabilities are guessed.
Phone status failure offers a reachable Retry phone status action without fabricated values.
Reconnecting and transport error are both shown after the fixture correction; no contradictory Connected label. Preference targets use full-row labels.
Long finite device name wraps cleanly beneath full-row preference labels without pushing checkbox targets outside the panel.
Environment picker and declared person rows fit; only synthetic options are present.
Loading discovery is explicit and does not present guessed options.
Separate people/environment failures wrap without overlapping their dismiss targets.
Locked person selection is readable; no unlocked account is implied.
Account sign-in action is visible and fits within the picker panel.
Real sign-in modal fits the phone with readable title, explanation and synthetic account action.
Real session-failure modal fits; dismiss, Retry session and account sign-in remain distinct and reachable.
Summary and Set up/Not now fit after replacing undersized browser-default buttons with themed 44px targets.
Expanded setup steps and actions fit the phone after touch-target repair; content is vertically bounded and scrollable.
Long finite network name and coordination URL wrap without horizontal clipping; themed 44px actions remain usable.
Connected state intentionally renders no network-join prompt; empty surface visually inspected.
No declared network intentionally renders no join prompt; empty surface visually inspected.
Android-specific setup steps and links wrap within the phone prompt; repaired buttons remain at least 44px.
iOS-specific setup instructions fit the phone prompt, with repaired touch buttons and bounded content.
Installer approval notice now includes the Update action its text instructs the person to use; status and action fit.
Download failure text wraps; Retry update and dismiss are separate reachable controls.
Idle update intentionally renders no interrupting notice; empty surface visually inspected.
